segments.text:
28 Nebuchadnezer ſpake and ſayd: Bleſſed is the
God of Sadrach, Meſach, and Abednego, who hath ſent his Angell and deliuered his ſeruauntes that put their truſt in hym, and haue chaunged the kynges commaundement, and yelded their bodyes, rather then they would worſhyp or ſerue any God ſaue theyr owne God.
